description: This source file defines functions for initializing and clearing an embedded Lua state within a server, with conditional compilation depending on the presence of Lua library headers.

methods.name: void li_lua_init(liLuaState * LL,liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk)
methods.description: Initializes a Lua state, sets up the Lua environment, and prepares synchronization primitives.

methods.name: void li_lua_clear(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Clears and frees the Lua state, and releases associated mutex lock.
